DLSS SDK binaries are NOT vendored here (NVIDIA SDK license).
Fetch at build time, pinned to v310.9.1:

  git clone --branch v310.9.1 --depth 1 https://github.com/NVIDIA/DLSS.git dlss-sdk
  git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers.git vulkan-headers

Required files (must both exist):
  dlss-sdk/lib/Windows_x86_64/x64/nvsdk_ngx_s.lib
  dlss-sdk/lib/Windows_x86_64/rel/nvngx_dlss.dll

Pinned nvngx_dlss.dll (v310.9.1):
  sha256 3975567b8943c53acce397f2b72380092f84f162d00b0d2c7d08a1025c563983
  size   58956912 bytes

Install targets (game folder D:\steam\steamapps\common\ProjectZomboid):
  natives/fsrupsc_ngx64.dll   <- MSVC build of vendor/upstream/fsrupsc_ngx.cpp
  natives/nvngx_dlss.dll    <- from the SDK, never re-hosted here

Source of this note: vendor/upstream/dlss-windows-build.md (upstream doc, fetched).
